name: submission-gate
description: Headlessly scan structured submission mail and verify a protected GitLab gate result with a canonical Manifest-S and rollback baseline.

interface.longDescription: Use one credential-free configuration and one controller across MCP, Skill, standalone CLI, and unattended OS scheduling. The gate scans `【提测】` mail idempotently, verifies HMAC when present, explicitly marks unsigned structured or plain fallback mail unverified, and fails closed on claimed-invalid authentication, missing evidence, or missing integrations.
defaultPrompt: Run submission gate setup with zero manual JSON editing.
Scan the gate mailbox once and process new `【提测】` mail.
Show blocked, passed, and skipped counts.
Diagnose dependency lock, mailbox access, and authoritative gate readiness.
